verdict.rationale: Evidence pack contains only ROCm software/framework support docs and generic AMD product feature marketing (HYPR-RX, Anti-Lag, FSR, SAM); there is no documented TDP/power envelope, no performance-per-watt benchmarking, and no independent testing of sustained workload efficiency. missing for 10: documented power envelope specs, independent perf-per-watt benchmarks, sustained-workload thermal/power testing.
